hero.title_html: Making Moroccan cheese a lever of food sovereignty.
hero.sub_html: The Cluster Filière Fromage-Agro (CFFA) brings together farmers, cooperatives, industrial companies, researchers and institutions to turn every liter of milk into sustainable value — in service of rural development and industrial excellence.
hero.women_caption_html: More than 1,000 women rural producers supported in the sector.
